newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 31.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- President Jiang Zemin tells visiting Japanese Foreign Minister Ikeda China and Japan should draw on historical experience to jointly create brighter future in relations.
- Premier Li Peng tells Japanese Foreign Minister Ikeda that China and Japan should work together to safeguard relations
- China to issue new one yuan note from April 1
- China in $1.2 billion telecommunications deal with U.S. firms, including digital optical-fibre cabe to link China and U.S.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Qiao Shi, chairman of National People's Congress on visit to France, hails Sino-French relations
PEOPLE'S DAILY OVERSEAS EDITION
- China to open trading rights on imports of rubber, steel, wood, cashmere, acrylic fibre, plywood in three years
- China to control trade in wheat, crude oil, oil products, fertiliser, cotton, tobacco
CHINA SECURITIES
- Chief economist of State Statistical Bureau sees 10 percent economic growth in 1996, inflation below 6.0 percent
- China to conduct annual checks on registered accounting firms
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Hubei branch of central bank issues rules to halt use of higher than official interest rates to attract deposits
- Central bank issues licence to Guilin Cooperative Bank
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Huaneng Group imports hit $30.9 million in 1996, exports $37.57 million
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- Jiujiang Petrochemical makes pre-tax profits of 656 million yuan in 1996
- Tarim oilfield produces more than 3.1 million tonnes crude in 1996, annual capacity reaches 4.4 million tonnes
- Suzhou court passes death sentence on Industrial and Commercial Bank official for creating losses of 840 million yuan and for graft
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- Chen Junsheng, head of China Supply and Marketing Cooperative says China must boost technology to raise cotton output
MARKET DAILY
- China to promote big beer brancs including Tsingtao and Zhujiang
CHINA DAILY
- Central bank official says banks should cut interest rates
